description: This file defines an API call function to fetch agents analytics data from a backend endpoint. It includes a single exported function `getAgentsAnalytics` which retrieves, normalizes, and returns analytics data related to agents.

methods.name: getAgentsAnalytics(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches grouped analytics data by agent with optional filters for tenant, project, time range, and pagination. Normalizes the API response into a consistent structure.
